pair_overrides.rationale: The same clause directly supports an Indra action and an entity-focused description; V3.1 says actions are separate but does not say whether DESCRIBES must also be emitted.
The words 'I offer' and 'adoration' directly support an offering event and the thing in its offered role; V3.1 gives no precedence or co-emission rule.
Both assertions bind to the exact request 'Be thou ... our guard and keeper'; one preserves the wording and one normalizes it to protection.
The packet does not settle whether filtered Soma in this occurrence should be modeled as the supplied canonical referent, a substance, or both; specialist review is required.
